quests.instruction: Select the most logically sound and cohesive opinion argument.
quests.prompt: 'Either we ban all phones at school or students will never pay attention.'
options: In my view, public transit deserves higher municipal subsidies because reduced fares decrease traffic congestion and greenhouse gas emissions.
Buses and trains are nice and everyone loves them so they should be completely free right now.
Transit is something you can ride every day of the week if you buy a ticket.
Because cars are expensive, nobody should ever drive anywhere in the city.
quests.correctAnswer: In my view, public transit deserves higher municipal subsidies because reduced fares decrease traffic congestion and greenhouse gas emissions.
quests.hint: Identify the option that balances a clear stance with a dual-benefit causal reason.
quests.explanation: The winning formulation employs the professional signpost "In my view" and substantiates the policy claim with two tangible societal benefits (congestion reduction and lower emissions).

distractorFeedback.Buses and trains are nice and everyone l: Overly emotional and subjective: claims "everyone loves them" without providing factual backing.
distractorFeedback.Transit is something you can ride every: This is a descriptive fact, not an opinion or persuasive argument.
distractorFeedback.Because cars are expensive, nobody shoul: An extreme fallacy that draws an unrealistic absolute conclusion from a single premise.
